linkedin:
12% of remote listings now explicitly require AI skills — 487 of 3,928 analyzed jobs.

The premium isn’t guaranteed, though. Only 22% of listings disclose pay, and 78% hide salary entirely. The highest disclosed range is USD 132,400–238,400 a year at Jabil. Communication (41%) still outranks AI (12%), leadership (11%), sales (9%), project management (8%), and data analysis (7%).

AI now shows up across engineering, people ops, sales, insurance, and even non-technical roles like a Live Ops Manager. For Indonesian job seekers targeting USD remote roles, it’s worth listing concrete AI work — frameworks, projects, public demos — but lead with domain expertise.

Full breakdown: https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/ai-skills-in-demand-for-remote-jobs-2026
